normalizationPolicy: Only absolute checkout/home paths, ephemeral Chrome profile paths and battery instance identifiers are normalized/redacted in public copies. All numeric JSON values, timestamps, arrays, counters, errors and source bytes are preserved except explicitly named metadata strings. PNG files are byte-identical. Source hashes identify untouched originals, sourceDecoded hashes identify their uncompressed bytes, decoded hashes identify normalized public bytes, and payload hashes identify archive bytes. No original capture was overwritten. This index covers copied payloads; README, audit and verifier are derived review artifacts.
sourceToPublicNumericEquality: Verified recursively for every JSON document; only explicitly normalized strings may differ.
